publisher: SONAR (one of the providers compared, scored by the same rules)

fields.name: Provider name.
fields.hq: Country of the head office or contracting entity, as its pages state it.
fields.kind: kyb, kyc-kyb, credit-kyb, data or screening (see kind_label).
fields.ranked: true when the provider sells a business check and is ranked; data and screening tools are listed, not ranked.
fields.publisher: true for SONAR, the publisher of the dataset (scored by the same rules).
fields.focus: What the provider says it is for, in one line.
fields.check_registry: Register record: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_officers: Directors and officers: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_owners: Owners and UBOs: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_sanctions: Sanctions: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_pep: PEP: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_adverse_media: Adverse media: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_documents: Company documents: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.check_monitoring: Ongoing monitoring: yes (included), addon (paid add-on), no (not offered) or unknown (not stated on its pages).
fields.coverage: Register coverage in the provider’s own words.
fields.names_uk_registers: Its pages name UK registers as covered.
fields.names_eu_registers: Its pages name EU registers as covered.
fields.names_us_registers: Its pages name US registers as covered.
fields.claims_100_plus_countries: Claims business coverage in 100 or more countries or jurisdictions.
fields.mcp: Has an MCP server or similar connection for AI agents to live data (documentation-only MCP servers do not count).
fields.self_serve: KYB can be bought online without talking to sales.
fields.free_start: Free credit, trial or plan you can start without sales, in its words; empty when none is stated.
fields.kyc_too: Also verifies people’s identity documents on the same platform.
fields.published_price: A KYB price (per check, or a plan that includes KYB) is published.
fields.no_minimum: KYB can be paid per check with no monthly fee and no minimum volume.
fields.price: Published KYB price in its words, before VAT, or "Not published".
fields.minimum: Monthly fee, minimum volume or contract, in its words.
fields.monthly_fee_amount: Lowest monthly fee its pages require before you can buy KYB (monthly billing); empty when none is required or not published.
fields.cost_5_checks_amount: What 5 company checks in a month cost at the published price: 5 x the price per check, or the monthly plan that includes them; empty when no price is published.
fields.cost_5_checks_from: true when the provider gives only a starting price.
fields.cost_5_checks_eur: cost_5_checks_amount in euros at the ECB reference rate of the edition, rounded to cents.
fields.note: Anything else its pages say that changes the picture.
fields.checked_on: Date the provider’s pages were opened (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.source_labels: The provider pages the facts come from (CSV: separated by " | ").
fields.source_urls: Their URLs, in the same order (CSV: separated by " | ").
